note: MDC area on the Gasconade River north-west of Manes, set aside for bowhunting. Camping is at the end of Bur Oak Lane, a gravel road across the river bottom: a gravel turnaround loop about 70 m long around a grass island, with a privy and a concrete boat ramp; no pads, tables or water. The river is about 40 m south of the loop behind a band of bank timber. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one designated camping point (map symbol + GIS point) at the gravel loop by the boat ramp - stays as a designated point at a lot. Privy written from the map. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Not waterfront stands (river behind bank timber). Pin move 42 m out of the woods. Phone matches. No brochure exists.
flags: DESIGNATED POINT (lot rule - STAYS): page lists 'Individual Campsites'; no brochure is posted. The 4/2/2019 map legend has 'Primitive Camping' and draws one symbol just west of the Parking Lot and Privy symbols and above the Concrete Boat Ramp symbol at the end of Bur Oak Lane. GIS layer 27: one 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 37.39650,-92.39989.

WHAT IS ON THE GROUND: a gravel one-way loop about 70 m long and 20 m wide with a grass island, a privy at its east end, and a gravel apron about 12 x 30 m running from its west end down to the concrete ramp. The GIS camping point is 42 m WEST of the loop, on a leafless wooded slope with no track or clearing visible at it - so the camping in practice is on the loop and its grass. Not a built camp; room for a few rigs.
PIN MOVE (42 m, out of the woods onto gravel): stored 37.39650,-92.39989 (GIS point, under canopy on the slope) -> proposed 37.39650,-92.39942, the west end of the gravel loop.

WATERFRONT - NOT WATERFRONT STANDS, noted for the owner: the Gasconade (25-30 m wide here) is 35-45 m south of the loop's south leg, behind a continuous band of bank trees 15-25 m deep; only the ramp cut is open, and that is the launch, not a place to camp. Water through standing timber is not a view, so it stays down. If the owner counts the ramp apron, a rig parked at the loop's west end looks down the ramp at the river about 30 m away - that would be riverview at most.

FLOODING: the loop is on the river bottom, a few metres above the water by the map's contours (river and loop both below the 1100-ft line); the page says nothing about flooding or closures. Not written to the note as fact.
PRIVY: map Privy symbol at the lot; the small building at the loop's east end on imagery. vault_toilets written.

ACCESS: Radford Drive (gravel county road) 1.5 miles from Highway 95, then Bur Oak Lane ('MDC Improved Road' on the map) about 700 m across open fields to the loop. No ford, no posted limit, no 4WD wording.
PHONE: stored 417-746-0291 matches the page's 'For more information call (417) 746-0291'.
No split (one point). Nothing else in the database within 3 km.
